name: Marcus Aurelius
blurb: A Roman emperor who wrote his private discipline down every night, never expecting anyone to read it.

name: Benjamin Franklin
blurb: Tracked thirteen virtues on a chart every day for years, one small mark at a time.

name: Marie Curie
blurb: Worked through cold, poverty and two Nobel Prizes on the same relentless, unglamorous focus.

name: Theodore Roosevelt
blurb: Built a sickly childhood into 'the strenuous life' by treating the body as the foundation, not an afterthought.

name: Florence Nightingale
blurb: Turned a hospital's chaos into a system, one meticulous record at a time.

name: The Quiet Operator
blurb: No name, no source — the archetype of someone who fixes what's broken and moves on without needing the credit.
